official: 大田区長等の給料の特例に関する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会区長提出議案

name: 区長等の給料を3か月間減額
summary: 区長と副区長の給料月額は、条例の別表で定められています。この議案では、区長の給料を3か月間30%減らし、副区長の給料を3か月間10%減らします。手当は減額の対象外です。
changes: 区長の給料月額を30%減らす
副区長の給料月額を10%減らす
why: 区長の給料を3か月間3割減額し、副区長の給料を3か月間1割減額するためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Cuts the mayor's and deputy mayor's salaries for three months
en.official: Ordinance on Special Provisions for the Salaries of the Ota City Mayor and Others
en.summary: The monthly salaries of the mayor and deputy mayor are set out in a separate table in the ordinance. Under this bill, the mayor's salary will be reduced by 30% for three months, and the deputy mayor's salary will be reduced by 10% for three months. Allowances are not subject to the reductions.
changes: Reduces the mayor's monthly salary by 30%
Reduces the deputy mayor's monthly salary by 10%
en.why: The ward says this is to reduce the mayor's salary by 30% for three months and the deputy mayor's salary by 10% for three months.
